correctness.rationale: Every colliding pair corresponds reversibly to opposite-parity factors x<y whose product is divisible by the odd modulus. Dividing by the even factor 2 and assigning each prime-power factor of m to one of the two coordinates proves the optimal complementary divisor lower bound; the bound is realized by every divisor pair. The minimizer is unique because distinct odd divisors cannot have product 2m; equality forces a unique factor pair and indices. Exact adjacent differences of F_a(u) settle the two exponent parities for all odd primes. All parameters and boundaries are explicit; 2500 direct scans and additional prime-power checks corroborate without replacing proof.
